item.title: EU fines X (Twitter) €120 million, Musk cuts off EU’s ad account
item.description: X has 60 days to explain how it plans to clean up misleading verified checkmarks, or risk more penalties.

item.title: Google AI nukes a hard drive, then apologizes harder than humans do
item.description: Instead of deleting a small cache folder like a sane being, the AI decided that meant wiping the entire drive.

item.title: OpenAI says it’s disabling ChatGPT suggestions that felt like ads
item.description: OpenAI insists they weren’t ads, or even tests for ads, but rather recommendations for third-party apps built within the new ChatGPT platform.

item.title: Meta hits pause on Phoenix headset for something shinier
item.description: A bold move unless Apple drops Vision Pro 2 first. Then all bets are off.

item.title: Anthropic’s Claude Code is coming to Slack
item.description: Anthropic hasn’t shared when Claude Code will move beyond beta.

item.title: Meta will finally limit personalized ads for EU users
item.description: EU officials say this is the “first time” Meta has offered this type of meaningful ad-control choice on its platforms.

item.title: ICEBlock developer sues feds after App Store takedown drama escalates
item.description: ICEBlock says the government unlawfully pressured Apple to yank the app from the App Store, which Apple eventually did.

item.title: People use Gemini more than ChatGPT
item.description: ChatGPT usage has dipped around 3% in recent months, while Gemini has seen a noticeable rise in daily engagement.

item.title: Social media is wrecking kids’ attention spans, new study warns
item.description: Social media is reshaping young minds, and not for the better. Kids aged 9-10 are seeing their attention spans dwindle as daily screen time jumps from 30 minutes to 2.5 hours.

item.title: Amazon issues urgent scam warnings—what shoppers must know
item.description: Amazon is sounding the alarm on impersonation scams this holiday season, urging shoppers to verify orders directly through their accounts.
